tasks.short: Collaborate on implementation of the chosen solution.

steps.what: List implementation tasks from the chosen solution.
Work with the owning team on implementation.
Change the plan when implementation hits a constraint.
Record what the implementation actually changed.

tasks.design: The {PROJECT} list is filled from the chosen solution. The work with the owning team, and any change when a constraint appears, stay with the analyst. The record uses the {PROJECT} fields the team already has. Native templates are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan lived in mail, and the constraint showed up in a meeting with no list.
tasks.enabler_now: A task list can be created from a solution's steps. Fitting it to the team cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A constraint the model treated as fixed.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst hears which step the owning team will not actually do.
tasks.altitude: Meetings stay. The analyst spends less time rebuilding the list after each conversation.

reach.task: Take a designed change into the system that must run it
reach.learn: Which design steps they have to rewrite once implementation starts

evidence.claim: Method choice, interpretation and advice to management stay with the analyst.
Implementation with the owning team is coordination, not a model run.

assumptions: Focal role is the operations research analyst. Boundary: from a chosen solution to an implementation record. Operating the process afterwards is out of scope.
Structured fields are task, owner, constraint and done or not. The analyst and the owning team produce them. Fallback: a task with no owner stays open.
Upkeep of 1.5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the task template.
unknowns: Whether the owning team already works in the same {PROJECT} tool.
Who can change the solution once implementation has started.
research_questions: What share of solutions are accepted and then changed in the first month?
How often is the constraint a data limit rather than a people limit?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the team rejects the solution's steps and the meetings are the whole task. High case: the list is reused and only the constraint talks stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Formulate mathematical models relating constants, variables and restrictions.

steps.what: State constants, variables and restrictions with the sponsor.
Formulate mathematical models of the problem.
Enter numerical parameters into the solver.
Run the solver on that formulation.
Adjust the model for conflicting objectives.

tasks.design: The sponsor meeting and the formulation stay with the analyst. Numerical parameters are entered once and the solver runs on the {DATA_PLATFORM}. Conflicting objectives are adjusted by the analyst, not by a search over unnamed goals.
tasks.previous_blocker: The formulation, the parameters and the run lived in one workbook that only the author could rerun.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored formulation can take new parameters. Choosing the variables and the restrictions cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Two objectives that cannot both be satisfied, and a sponsor who will not say which gives way.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst chooses the trade-off the sponsor can live with.

ambition.what: A one-page formulation a sponsor can read before the solver is run.

tasks.altitude: Formulation stays the core of the week. Reruns with new parameters take less time.

reach.task: Turn a stated calculation into a job someone else can rerun
reach.learn: Which inputs they insist are named before a run

evidence.claim: Method choice, interpretation and advice to management stay with the analyst.
A solver can compute a stated formulation. It does not choose the restrictions.

assumptions: Focal role is the operations research analyst. Boundary: from a problem definition to an adjusted formulation. Embedding the solver in a product is out of scope.
Structured fields are variable, constant, restriction, parameter and objective. The analyst names them. Fallback: a parameter with no source is not entered.
Test the platform's existing solver job before custom code.
Upkeep of 2.5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the job definition when parameters change.
unknowns: Whether a solver is already available, or runs are still in a local workbook.
Who may change an objective after the sponsor meeting.
research_questions: What share of models are reruns with new parameters rather than new formulations?
How often do conflicting objectives appear only after the first run?

incremental.description: Keep solver job definitions aligned with named parameters

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: each problem needs a new formulation and a long sponsor meeting. High case: the structure is stable and only parameters and the conflict review change.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe the current system and gather component problems.

steps.what: Observe the current system while it operates.
Gather information from operators and records.
Sort component problems from those sources.

loop.check: Analyst drops a problem that is not in the notes
loop.stop: One pass; no note means no line
loop.why_not_simpler: Notes are free text from a floor visit

tasks.design: Watching the system stays on site. Notes from operators are sorted into a component list, and the analyst deletes any line the notes do not support. The {PROJECT} record is a filing step, not a substitute for the visit.
tasks.previous_blocker: The visit, the interviews and the list were one notebook.
tasks.enabler_now: A list with a source note can be filed. Being on the floor cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A problem that only shows while the system is running.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst notices the workaround operators do not call a problem.
tasks.altitude: Visits stay. The write-up of component problems takes less of the next day.

reach.task: Watch a live system before naming a component fault
reach.learn: Which faults they will not name from a log alone

evidence.claim: Seeing a running operation is not replaced by a summary of notes.

assumptions: Focal role is the operations research analyst. Boundary: from time on the floor to a filed component list. Designing the future system is out of scope.
Structured fields are component, problem and source note. The analyst writes them from the visit. Fallback: a line with no source note is deleted.
Test a {PROJECT} list before custom code. Do not replace the visit.
Upkeep of 1 hour per 100 baseline hours covers the list fields.
unknowns: Whether the analyst is allowed on the floor for a full cycle of the operation.
Which records already describe component problems.
research_questions: What share of problems are visible only during the operation?
How often do operator interviews add a problem the visit missed?

already_counted.description: Source check on the problem list

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the operation is irregular and the visit is almost the whole task. High case: only sorting and filing shrink. The observation does not move.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze information from management and define the operational problem.

loop.check: Analyst checks each point against the brief
loop.stop: One pass; a point with no sentence in the brief is dropped

steps.what: Define the operational problem from those points.
Check the definition with the manager.

tasks.design: Points are extracted from the management brief and checked. Defining the operational problem, and confirming it with the manager, stay with the analyst. The {PROJECT} record stores the confirmed wording only.
tasks.previous_blocker: The brief was reread in the meeting, and the definition was rewritten afterwards from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: A short point list makes gaps in the brief visible. It does not define the problem.
tasks.still_hard: Management's words describe a symptom, not the decision they need.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst hears the decision hiding inside the complaint.

ambition.what: The analyst decides in the confirmation meeting whether the problem is defined well enough to model.

tasks.altitude: Confirmation meetings stay. Less time is spent reconstructing what the brief said.

reach.task: Turn a manager's incident note into a defined problem before analysis
reach.learn: How they separate a symptom from the decision to be made

evidence.claim: Method choice, interpretation and advice to management stay with the analyst.

assumptions: Focal role is the operations research analyst. Boundary: from a management brief to a confirmed problem record. Building the model is out of scope.
Structured fields are symptom, scope, constraint and decision needed. The brief is the source; the analyst defines the decision. Fallback: a point not in the brief is dropped.
Test a {DOCS} template before custom code.
Upkeep of 1 hour per 100 baseline hours covers the problem template.
unknowns: Whether briefs arrive as a memo, a slide or a conversation.
Who confirms that the problem is the right one.
research_questions: What share of briefs already name the decision?
How often does the manager change the definition in the meeting?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the brief is a conversation and the definition is built in the meeting. High case: the point list is useful and only the definition and the meeting stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Sponsor meetings, floor visits and implementation talks stay. Parameter entry and write-ups shrink. The analyst can refuse a parameter that has no source.
reach: Software developers name inputs before a job can be rerun
Systems engineers do not name a fault from a log alone
skills_to_grow: Writing variables and restrictions so someone else can rerun them
Marking a floor note that actually supports a problem
Separating a management symptom from the decision
role.ambitious_version: The analyst spends the week on formulation, the floor and the owning team, with parameters and problem lists already traced to a source.
